title: WorkOrder (minimum schema)
description: SP-20260718-005 Phase 3, unit BE-1. The minimum shape a WorkOrder must satisfy before role-resolver.deriveBinding treats a dispatch as validated_workorder_or_cli_binding (ED-218). Same-session artifact — trust anchor is the per-session HMAC (attest-signing.js) over workorder_digest (BE-3), NOT this schema file at runtime; scripts/dispatch/workorder-schema.js#validate is a hand-rolled, dependency-free validator that implements this shape (kept in sync by hand — see the header comment there).

schema_version.description: WorkOrder schema version this record was authored against.

correlation_id.description: Correlates this WorkOrder to its dispatch/ledger records.

role.description: The EFFECTIVE (resolved) role of the dispatched worker.

provider.description: The EFFECTIVE provider (e.g. claude, openai, antigravity).

base_commit.description: IMMUTABLE base commit SHA the worker branched from. Never mutated post-issue; freshness is re-asserted at merge time (BE-6), never rewritten here.

result_tree_hash.description: The result-tree hash the worker's output is bound to.

allowed_capabilities.description: The capability allowlist granted to this dispatch.

allowed_paths.description: The path allowlist (file/dir scope) granted to this dispatch.

retry_lineage.description: Ordered lineage of prior attempts for this correlation_id (empty on a first attempt).

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence artifacts produced/consumed by this WorkOrder (empty is valid).

terminal_state.description: EXACTLY these 5 states. Not a failure-reason — see failure_reason for the CLASS taxonomy.

failure_reason.description: A CLASS taxonomy, not a state — describes WHY a non-success terminal_state was reached. Required when terminal_state !== 'success'; must be absent when terminal_state === 'success'. model_unavailable predicts the harness-spawn bug class (ED-208-adjacent).
